source_comparison.basis: same seven training seeds and fixed train-derived validation partition

findings: All 91 payload cells, including 84 trained adapters, passed receipt-bound artifact and log validation.

The same-seed replay broadly reproduced the prior seven-seed results. Final Acc@1 differences were 0.00 pp for frozen base, -0.25 pp for Q5, +3.11 pp for PIS, +1.07 pp for ReST-EM, +0.50 pp for STaR, -0.11 pp for TRICE-CV and -1.46 pp for RLOO.
Trajectory AUC was especially stable: the absolute replay difference was at most 0.62 pp for every source-mapped method.
Frozen-reader answer-guided Q5 reached 81.32% Final Acc@1, compared with 80.32% for its moving-reader control; the paired interval includes no effect.
Answer-guided PIS degraded to 63.64% Final Acc@1, while question-prompt PIS reached 80.00%.
limitations: This deliberately reuses the historical seeds and train-derived validation questions, so it is reproducibility evidence rather than fresh method-selection evidence.
Learned runs are not bit-exact; PIS has the largest endpoint replay difference despite nearly unchanged trajectory AUC.
The official GSM8K test split remained sealed.

findings: All 42 payload cells and trained adapters passed validation.
Q5-MORE improved Final Acc@1 by +0.57 pp, strict final accuracy by +2.93 pp and trajectory AUC by +0.64 pp over canonical answer-guided Q5; only the strict and AUC intervals excluded zero.
Token-mean Q5 was harmful, reducing Final Acc@1 by 3.79 pp and strict final accuracy by 10.21 pp.
PIS with one update was worse than four updates, while rationale-only KL produced no improvement over the four-update PIS control.
Exact signed updates improved extracted accuracy at one update but severely damaged strict formatting; four reused exact-signed updates collapsed strict final accuracy to 8.57%.
limitations: These are paired seven-seed follow-ups against controls from the selected-method posterity replay.
The official GSM8K test split remained sealed.
next_actions: Treat Q5-MORE as the only positive follow-up signal, while retaining the uncertainty on Final Acc@1.
Do not advance token-mean Q5, rationale-only PIS KL or exact-signed update reuse under their tested settings.
Use a fresh held-out or official-test confirmation only after the final method is frozen.
